rows.ko: 1. 역할 나누기: 점성술은 나를 돌아보게 하는 상징 언어이고, 실천 제안은 쏠 웰니스 하우스의 전문 상담사가 설계한 웰니스 방법입니다. 점성술 해석을 상담사가 보증하는 것처럼 쓰지 않습니다. "별이 이렇게 말하니 반드시 그렇게 된다"가 아니라 "이 시기의 하늘은 이런 질문을 던진다 → 그 질문 앞에서 해볼 수 있는 것은 이것이다"의 흐름입니다.
rows.en: 1. Keep the roles separate: astrology is a symbolic language that helps people reflect on themselves, while the suggested practices are wellness methods designed by SSOL Wellness House's therapists or counselors. Never write as though the counselors stand behind the astrological reading. The logic is not "the stars say so, so it will definitely happen," but "the sky right now raises this question → here's something you can try in response."
rows.en_before_tone: 1. Division of roles: astrology is a symbolic language for self-reflection, and the practice suggestions are wellness methods designed by SSOL Wellness House's professional counselors. rows.en: - Voice and rhythm: write as a confident, warm horoscope writer. Use the active voice and make "you" (the reader) or a planet the subject ("You feel…", "Saturn asks you to…", "Jupiter opens…"); avoid passive constructions and dummy openers like "It is…", "There is/are…" or "This is a year when…". Cut hedges ("may", "might", "perhaps", "possibly", "it can help to"): keep at most one soft hedge per paragraph, and only where a sentence would otherwise promise something about health, money or another person's feelings. Include an imperative about once per advice paragraph ("Trust your pace.", "Write it down tonight."). Choose elegant, slightly mystical vocabulary (luminous, threshold, steadfast, momentum); if you use a genuinely hard or archaic word, gloss it in parentheses right after it ("a liminal (in-between) season"), at most once per section. Use standard English horoscope idioms ("doors of opportunity open wide", "you ride the current", "a supportive mentor steps into your life"), never slang. Vary sentence length and rhythm: never start 3 or more sentences in a row with the same word or structure (no exceptions; the count carries over across paragraph breaks).

It doesn't have to switch perfectly every sentence, but within one section, the same ending style must not continue for 3 or more sentences in a row (no exceptions). The count continues across paragraph breaks. If the same ending has run for 2 sentences, you may change only the ending of the third while keeping the meaning ("~돼요" → "~됩니다"). Neither style may exceed 65% of the total. In particular, do not use "~이에요" back to back.

Then, {{흐름근거}}, Jupiter opens more room for you to show your true colors among kindred spirits who share your wavelength. Get ready for that moment: choose one piece of your current studies or work that feels 'so me' and shape it into a small finished piece before the month is out.</잇기>
rows.en_before_tone: <잇기>For Jiwoo, who wishes for Being myself, this is a year when you become more yourself the more you choose, rather than the sky deciding for you. Around {{U_월}}, take the offers or nudges Uranus brings not as something that topples your current path, but as a chance to check which way of working feels most natural to you. Then, from {{흐름근거}}, you're likely to find more chances to show your true colors among people who think like you. So you have something ready for that moment, pick one piece of your current study or work that feels 'so me' and turn it into a small finished piece before this month ends.</잇기>

rows.en: <잇기>You long for Stability, yet this year family responsibilities reach your shoulders first. During {{S_기간}}, Saturn squares your Moon and family matters crowd your heart, so don't carry everything alone: choose the one thing that is truly yours to handle. Then, {{흐름근거}}, Jupiter brings fresh air into your home and your heart, little by little. Make that your steadfast anchor, the one thing you hold even when life shakes: starting this week, set aside Sunday evenings for a cup of tea with your family.</잇기>
rows.en_before_tone: <잇기>Unlike your wish for Stability, this is a year when family responsibilities tend to land on your shoulders first. Especially during {{S_기간}}, as Saturn forms a tense angle with your Moon, family matters may pile up on your mind, so rather than carrying everything alone, it helps to decide on just one thing that is truly yours to handle. Thankfully, from {{흐름근거}}, a little breathing room begins to open up at home and in your heart. As your one anchor to hold onto even when shaken, try setting aside time for a cup of tea with your family on Sunday evenings, starting this week.</잇기>

rows.en: <잇기>Love is your wish, Jiwoo, and across the next five years its brightest season arrives in {{열리는해}}. In {{열리는해}}, Jupiter forms a harmonious trine with Venus and your feelings find their words with ease, so keep the door open, whether to someone new or to the next chapter of a bond you already share. Just before that, {{역풍해}} makes love's strings and responsibilities feel weightier; treat that year as a crucible (a testing ground) for learning the distance and pace that feel right to you, and you meet your Open Year on steadier feet. Start now: choose one day each month to tell someone you're grateful for exactly what they mean to you.</잇기>
rows.en_before_tone: <잇기>For Jiwoo, who wishes for Love, the most welcome time in the next five years is {{열리는해}}. In {{열리는해}}, Jupiter harmonizes with Venus and expressing your feelings becomes much easier, so it's a good year to keep the door open — whether to a new connection or to the next step in your current relationship. In {{역풍해}} before that, the conditions and responsibilities that come with relationships may feel heavy, but if you use that time to learn the distance and pace that feel comfortable to you, you'll be less shaken when the opening year arrives. This year, start by setting one day a month to tell someone you're grateful to how you feel, in words.</잇기>

In {{가까운해}}, Jupiter tours your money & possessions area and makes it easier to choose what strengthens the foundation of your everyday life, so set your sights on that year.
